packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one grouped pull request.
Packages whose files the website keeps in the repository: the pull request needs scripts/vendor.py.
prBodyNotes: Files of this package are kept in the repository: on this branch, run `npm ci --ignore-scripts && python3 scripts/vendor.py && python3 scripts/build.py --check` and commit the files `vendor.py` changed, nothing else (README.md and full-list.md are left to the Version workflow), before merging (Check fails until then).

packageRules.description: Python tools of the checks: locked with hashes by uv pip compile (tests/*.in → tests/*.txt); the plain requirements manager leaves the lock files alone.
Python of the Tidy workflow: pyoxipng has wheels for Python 3.13 only (tests/requirements-tidy.in); raise it with that lock once pyoxipng ships wheels for a newer Python.

Base image of the fuzzing (.clusterfuzzlite/Dockerfile), rebuilt upstream every day: its digest is renewed once a month, in one pull request. Without the 3-day delay, which a digest replaced every day would never pass; the fuzzing job holds no secret and only reads.
